slides.texte_overlay:
rare traits that make people
impossible to forget

sincere warmth

they make everyone feel welcome, from the waiter to the boss. people forget what you said, but they always remember how warm and wanted you made them feel.

calm confidence

they don't need to be loud to be noticed. a calm voice, steady eyes and a relaxed smile leave a far deeper impression than trying hard to impress anyone in the room.

endless curiosity

i was the forgettable one in every group until i started learning something fascinating every day. curious people always have a story, and stories are what people remember.
slides.texte_sophia:
endless curiosity

i was the one nobody noticed in groups. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and people remember the stories i tell for weeks.

slides.texte_overlay:
a memory for others

they remember your name, your dog and the exam you were nervous about. feeling remembered is so rare that people never forget the person who made them feel that way.

honest kindness

they tell the truth gently, even when it's hard to hear. people trust and remember those who manage to be honest and kind at exactly the same time, every time.
